item.title: Forum: The day’s catch from the dock for a grandson and buddies
item.description: Not a squid was snagged, but a hat was fished from the drink, as was laughter and honest joy.

item.title: Comment: Flock cameras need rules to protect public’s privacy
item.description: Legislation would create regulations for data collected by license plate cameras and prevent abuses.

item.title: Comment: County should follow board’s order on critical habitat
item.description: Snohomish groups advised that critical area protections were lacking. A state board has now agreed.

item.title: Roberts: Whatever EPA protecting it’s not environment or us
item.description: Its scuttling of a 2009 climate finding could doom the U.S. to economic and environmental losses.

item.title: Editorial: Hope flickers to ‘irrigate’ the state’s news deserts
item.description: Two journalism programs are joining forces, but the state still can help provide a funding source.

item.title: King’s girls basketball breezes into 1A State quarterfinals
item.description: The Knights use second-quarter run to seize control, beat Lakeside (9 Mile) 61-38 on Friday.

item.title: Shorewood boys basketball outlasts Monroe in 3A State Tournament
item.description: The Stormrays ‘dig in’ to reach Round of 12 with 51-48 win over Bearcats on Friday.

item.title: Snohomish girls basketball scraps to quarterfinals
item.description: The No. 2 Panthers pull away from No. 7 Evergreen late to advance in the state tournament on Saturday.

item.title: State girls basketball roundup and schedule
item.description: No. 15 Meadowdale girls blow out No. 10 Enumclaw to earn trip to Tacoma Dome

item.title: State boys basketball roundup and schedule
item.description: Glacier Peak falls to the defending Class 4A champs and will play in Wednesday’s Round of 12.
